messages.context: 尝试向博物馆捐赠不符合条件的物品
messages.raw: §cYou cannot donate that item to your Museum!
messages.text: You cannot donate that item to your Museum!
messages.gloss: Museum 沿用既定译名“博物馆”。
messages.zh: 这件物品无法捐赠给博物馆!

messages.context: 捐赠物品后获得空岛经验
messages.raw: §aYou donated your §c%1$s §ato the §d%2$s §asection of the Museum! §b+%3$s SkyBlock XP
messages.text: You donated your %1$s to the %2$s section of the Museum! +%3$s SkyBlock XP

placeholders.desc: 捐出的物品名，保留英文

messages.context: 从博物馆取回一件已捐赠物品
messages.text: You retrieved your %1$s from the Museum!

placeholders.desc: 取回的物品名，保留英文

messages.gloss: 物品名保留英文；只翻译固定的取回动作。

messages.context: 特殊物品提示：计入博物馆进度但不计入总物品价值
messages.raw: §7It still counts towards your §3Museum§7 progress, but not towards your §6total item value§7.
messages.text: It still counts towards your Museum progress, but not towards your total item value.
messages.gloss: total item value 指博物馆估值，不是单件物品价格。
messages.zh: 它仍计入你的博物馆进度，但不计入物品总价值。

messages.zh: 你同时获得了以下进度:

messages.text: You have %1$s unclaimed rewards! CLICK HERE to view your Museum rewards.
